description: The published criteria for the Payload Budget Check service (token-efficiency/v1): the input contract, the four shaping operations S-1..S-4, the receipt and reconciliation rules, the pinned tokenizer (cl100k_base, gpt-tokenizer 4.1.0), and the pinned public test corpus identity. Read these before paying for a budget check — every report is reproducible from them. — no payment required: call directly without payment (no x402 challenge; this tool is free). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/token-efficiency/criteria.
